observations: The page number «45» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L14-L15: the heading of chapter 9, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it.

L02: the formula «tg aeq. = e sin m / (1 + e cos m)» is printed as a built-up fraction, «e sin m» over «1 + e cos m», e and m in italics; written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}. Checked: for the eccentric of figure p. 44 (JP2 0076) with MS = 1, ME = e and the mean anomaly m = ∢ AMS from the apogee, the vector SM is (cos m, −sin m) and SE is (e + cos m, −sin m) when A lies in the direction (−1, 0) from M, so that tan α = e sin m / (1 + e cos m).

L24-L30: the computation of the anomaly, set as a table: the words joined to the figures by dotted leaders (L25, L27), which are not transcribed, the ditto marks „ under «Zunahme für»; L28 «Summa :» below a rule, without «=»; L29 «— 360°» under the sum. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the words room and are not printed. Checked: 61° 52′ 40″ + 348° 56′ 57″ + 31° 56′ 59″ + 182° 54′ 36″ = 625° 41′ 12″, less 360° 265° 41′ 12″; with Brahmagupta's parameters (57 753 300 000 revolutions of the moon and 488 105 858 of its apogee in 1 577 916 450 000 days, see p. 42, JP2 0074) the 29 years, 10277 days, give 348° 56′ 58″, thirty days 31° 56′ 59″ and fourteen days 182° 54′ 36″. L31-L34 and N04: 4° 54′ 52″ + 15″ = 4° 55′ 7″; 314° 6′ 28″ + 4° 55′ 7″ = 319° 1′ 35″, 19° 1′ 35″ of Aquarius (from 300°).

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.», «Nallino», «Kh.», «Burgess», «Ptol.», «Brahmaguptas»; italics: «Gleichung» (L01, L31), «e», «ME», «MA», «Sūrya-Siddhānta», «Argumentum lunae», «Evectio», «Prosneusis», «Beispiel», «Anomalie» (L24, L30), «wahren Ort». L23: «15. Ṣafar» upright, where p. 42 and p. 43 set it in italics.

N02: «Nallino», between the n and the o a speck like an apostrophe and a dot below the line; L35: a speck above the line after «41′,»; N01: a dot in the margin before the note number; not transcribed. N04: «265° Grad», as printed.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (9-15 px measured).
